coverage_intervals.source_semantics: §5.2 heading only, no additional independent author mathematical claim

Euclidean quaternionic twistor model T=C4=H2, projective quaternionic lines HP1=S4, explicitly compared with 2d CP1=S2 right-chiral construction and group action. An author-source geometric context, not new proof.

Two-dimensional orientation-conditioned identification R2 with C is single notion; four-dimensional orthogonal complex structures parametrized by SO4/U2=CP1 and are not a unique canonical tangent complex structure.
For four-manifold M, Z(M) is six-real-dimensional bundle with SO4/U2 fibers encoding tangent complex structures; under M spin, Z(M)=P(S_R) projectivized right spinor bundle.
If M is hyperkähler, Z(M)=M×CP1 as source-stated conditional product; no claim for arbitrary M.
Special S4 case Z(S4)=CP3 with complex total twistor space, while S4 base itself has no complex structure or holomorphic function theory as a complex manifold; must preserve distinction.
Author states Z(M) is complex when M has anti-self-dual curvature; this is CONDITIONAL, not claim every Riemannian four-manifold has complex twistor space.
